# mvmctl

> mvmctl manages Firecracker microVMs on Linux with KVM. Choose the reference that matches your `mvm --version` output. The environment blueprint's schema version is separate from the mvmctl release version.

## Versioned references

- [0.2 reference](https://mvmctl.aland20.com/docs/0.2/llm.txt): Quickstart, complete command manual, and environment blueprint manual for v0.2.0.
- [0.3 prerelease reference](https://mvmctl.aland20.com/docs/0.3/llm.txt): Operator guidance, command reference, and environment blueprint directives for the 0.3 prerelease.
- [0.3 reference checksum](https://mvmctl.aland20.com/docs/0.3/llm.txt.sha256): SHA-256 checksum for the 0.3 text file.

## Guides

- [0.2 docs](https://mvmctl.aland20.com/docs/0.2/): Install and first VM for the v0.2.0 release.
- [0.3 prerelease docs](https://mvmctl.aland20.com/docs/0.3/): Install and first VM for the 0.3 prerelease.
- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/AlanD20/mvmctl/releases)
